activation.title: Activate KamChi or Start Free
activation.subtitle: Works 100% offline. Your lending records always stay on your device.
activation.deviceCodeHint: Send this code to the seller if you want a license key bound to this phone.
activation.telegramPrefill: Hello KamChi, I would like to purchase the {{plan}} plan. My Device Code is: {{deviceCode}}
activation.keyPlaceholder: Paste your KC1-... license key here
activation.continueFreeNote: Free plan supports up to {{maxLoans}} active loans with zero account required.
activation.newPhoneDesc: Device-bound keys work only on this phone. On a new phone, send your new Device Code to the seller on Telegram to receive a replacement key. Unbound keys work on any device.

qr.title: Scan License QR Code
qr.subtitle: Point your camera at the KC1 license QR code.
qr.unsupported: Live camera is unavailable here. Use "Choose QR image" below or paste your license key.
qr.permissionDenied: Camera access was denied. Enable camera permission, choose a QR image below, or paste your key.
qr.noQrFoundInImage: No QR code was found in that image. Make sure the QR code is clear and try again.
qr.notKamChiQr: A QR code was detected, but it does not contain a KamChi (KC1-) license key.

errors.emptyKey: Please paste, scan, or import a license key first.
errors.invalidFormat: Invalid license key format. Keys must start with KC1- and contain valid characters.
errors.checksumFailed: The license key has a typo or checksum error. Please check every character or re-import the file.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This license key requires a newer version of KamChi.
errors.invalidSignature: This license key signature could not be verified.
errors.wrongDevice: This license key belongs to a different phone (Device Code does not match).
errors.expiredKey: This license key has already expired. Please request a renewed key.
errors.storageUnavailable: Local device storage is unavailable. License state may not persist in private browsing.
errors.fileReadFailed: Could not read the selected license file.

banners.clockTamperedBody: Your device date appears earlier than when KamChi was last used. License timing is checked against your latest verified date to stay accurate.
banners.expiringSoonBody: Renew before {{date}} to keep unlimited loans, exports, and backups uninterrupted.
banners.graceBody: Your license expired on {{date}}. Renew soon before KamChi switches to read-only mode.
banners.readOnlyBody: Your license has expired. All existing records stay visible, searchable, exportable, and payments can still be recorded. Creating new loans or borrowers requires renewing or switching to Free.

settings.removeConfirmDesc: Your borrowers, loans, and payments will NOT be deleted. Features will switch to the Free plan (up to {{maxLoans}} active loans).
settings.removedToast: License removed. Switched to Free plan.

upgradePrompt.descFreeLimit: The Free plan supports up to {{maxLoans}} active loans. Existing loans remain fully accessible. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited loans.
upgradePrompt.descFreeInstallmentLimit: The Free plan supports up to {{maxInstallments}} active installment loans. Existing plans remain accessible. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited installment sales.
upgradePrompt.descExport: Upgrade to KamChi Pro to export PDF contracts/schedules, P&L reports, and Excel workbooks.
upgradePrompt.descBackup: Upgrade to KamChi Pro to export or restore full encrypted JSON backups of your ledger.
upgradePrompt.descTelegram: Upgrade to KamChi Pro to send due-date reminders directly via Telegram.
upgradePrompt.descStaff: Upgrade to KamChi Business to manage multiple collector and owner accounts.
upgradePrompt.descContracts: Upgrade to KamChi Business to generate custom loan agreement contracts (full contract workflows expanding soon).
upgradePrompt.descReadOnly: Your license expired past its 7-day grace period. You can still view, search, export records, and record payments on existing loans. Renew your key or switch to Free to add new records.
